title: String to Union
description:
Implement a recursive `Split<S, D>` type that splits a string literal type `S` by delimiter `D` into a union of the parts.

**Example:**
```ts
type A = Split<'a,b,c', ','>  // 'a' | 'b' | 'c'
type B = Split<'x|y', '|'>    // 'x' | 'y'
type C = Split<'solo', ','>   // 'solo'
```
starter_code: export type Split<S extends string, D extends string> = // your type here
solution: export type Split<S extends string, D extends string> = S extends `${infer H}${D}${infer T}` ? H | Split<T, D> : S;
ai_context: Common mistake: not making Split recursive — only splitting the first occurrence. The `H | Split<T, D>` recursion is required to continue splitting the tail. Also ensure the base case returns `S` (not `never`) for strings with no delimiter.
